name: Carlos Alcaraz
intro: Carlos Alcaraz is a tennis superstar from Spain. His friends call him Carlitos. He won this tournament last year!
story: Carlos started playing at age four. His dad was a tennis coach. At 19 he became the youngest world No. 1 ever. He has won seven Grand Slams, the biggest tournaments in tennis. On Friday he beat Yibing Wu, and he plays again Sunday.

funFacts.text: He has three brothers: Alvaro, Sergio and Jaime. Alvaro helps coach him.
He loves golf and soccer. His favorite team is Real Madrid.
He eats lots of kebabs at home in Murcia. He loves sushi too.
His favorite movie is Rocky Balboa. His favorite actor is Will Smith.
This year he played doubles with Serena Williams. They giggled through their first win!
He became world No. 1 at 19. Nobody has ever done it younger.
His tennis hero is Rafael Nadal, another champion from Spain.

watchFor: Watch his drop shot, a sneaky soft shot, then his giant grin.

notes: Seven Grand Slams confirmed via Wikipedia title list (USO 2022, W 2023, RG 2024, W 2024, RG 2025, USO 2025, AO 2026). 2025 US Open champion confirmed.
